items.title: 7.5 Hypothesis testing ke liye data visualisation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of data visualisation for hypothesis testing (PDF 100-101).

blocks.text: Data visualisation data ko wazeh pesh karti hai, taake shumariyati tests se pehle naqsh, rujhanat aur rishte dekhe ja sakein. Tasaveer pecheeda data samajhna asan, ghalat-fehmiyan kam, groups ke farq ka muwazna asan, aur outliers aur be-qaidagiyan dhoondne mein madad deti hain (Fig 7.2). Yeh basari saboot deti hain jo behtar faislon mein madad karta hai.

Visualisation kache data ko ba-maani basari shaklon mein badalti aur researchers ko aise bare datasets samajhne mein madad deti hai jo numbers ki shakal mein mushkil hon. Yeh rujhanat, taqseem aur farq numayan karti, nataij takneeki aur ghair-takneeki sameen ko samjhana asan banati, aur ghair-maamooli naqsh dikha kar ghaltiyan kam karti hai.

blocks.caption: Nataij pesh karne ke charts
rows: Categories ya groups ka muwazna, jaise control aur treatment group
Waqt ke saath rujhan aur tabdeeliyan
Do variables ka rishta, aur outliers dhoondna

blocks.alt: Teen panels. Bar chart: control group ki patti mean 62, saath oonchi treatment group ki patti mean 78. Line graph: waqt ke saath do lines, A tezi se charhti aur B ahista. Scatter plot: variable 1 ke muqable neeche baen se oopar daen charhte nuqte, aik surkh nuqta baqiyon se door, outlier.
blocks.caption: Hypothesis-test nataij pesh karne ke charts (Fig 7.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har chart alag sawal ka jawab deta hai: groups kaise mukhtalif hain, cheezein kaise badalti hain, ya do variables kaise saath chalte hain.

blocks.text: Tasaveer nataij ko seedha hypothesis se jorti hain, taake researchers dekh sakein ke data us ki tayeed karta hai ya nahi. Muwazna chart control aur treatment groups ka farq dikha sakta, line graph mutawaqqa rujhan ki tasdeeq kar sakta, aur scatter plot hypothesis mein bayan rishta dikha sakta hai. Basari saboot istidlal ko mazboot karta hai, agarche faisla khud shumariyati test se hi aata hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa chart behtareen dikhayega ke treatment group ke average number control group se zyada the, aur phir bhi test kyun karna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Do groups ke means ka bar chart. Chart farq dikhata hai, lekin sirf hypothesis test batata hai ke farq ittifaq se bara hai ya nahi.

items: Visualisation testing se pehle aur baad naqsh, farq aur outliers dikhati.
Bar: groups; line: rujhan; pie: hisse; scatter: rishte.
Tasaveer faisle ki tayeed karti magar test ki jagah nahi leti.
